name: it.magius.gamedek
description: Fancy themable panel to place all game links.

scripts.update: npm install && for d in ./plugins/*/ ; do (cd "$d" && npm install); done
scripts.gitpull: git pull && for d in ./plugins/*/ ; do (cd "$d" && git checkout main && git pull); done
scripts.aur-make: cd archlinux-aur && rm -rf *.zst && makepkg -f && echo "install with: yay -U archlinux-aur/$(ls -1 *.zst)"
scripts.aur-install: npm run aur-make && yay -U $(ls -t1 archlinux-aur/*.zst | head -n 1) && npm run local-update-plugins-themes
scripts.local-update-plugins-themes: rm ~/.local/share/GameDek/plugins -rf && rm ~/.local/share/GameDek/themes -rf && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/GameDek/plugins && cp plugins/* ~/.local/share/GameDek/plugins/ -r && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/GameDek/themes && cp themes/* ~/.local/share/GameDek/themes/ -r

linux.description: Fancy themable panel to place all game links.

desktop.Name: GameDek
desktop.Comment: Fancy themable panel to place all game links.
